iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

MR_EGRESS
       Raised after the route has been selected and processed and the message is delivered to the mr_proxy.

DESCRIPTION
       This event is raised after the route has been selected and processed and the message is delivered to the mr_proxy for
       forwarding on the new connflow.

Examples
	when MR_INGRESS {
	    set client_addr "[IP::remote_addr]:[TCP::remote_port]"
	    MR::store client_addr
	}
	when MR_EGRESS {
	    MR::restore client_addr
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the event.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
